title: HARNESS-W7 and HARNESS-W8 closed in roadmap, but their own qualification records still read READY FOR AUDIT with no acceptance stamp or in-repo audit artifact
affected_invariant: roadmap closure evidence; FRZ-EXE/GOV scoped contribution
impact: Same pattern as the SCHED-01 finding already filed in A1: acceptance exists only as a roadmap/ledger statement and as downstream references (HARNESS-FINAL, CE-01). Records were last modified at the certification SHA and never received the acceptance bookkeeping that CE-01/GOV-X2/CTRL-X/STATE-X got. HARNESS-FINAL replay (244 passed) mitigates the technical risk.
recommendation: Owner adds acceptance stamp plus audit reference (or states the acceptance basis) to both records, or parent treats W7/W8 closure as roadmap-claim only.

title: W7/W8/SCHED-01 closed with unclassified or unowned failing gates: 7 failed tenant/identity tests and 1 failed GR6 test absent from W7 unresolved table; npsc42 allowlist failure handed to HARNESS-FINAL, which never mentions it
impact: W7 asserts tenant audit PASS and unclassified = 0 while its own run table shows 80 passed / 7 failed and a failed GR6 strict-host composition test, neither listed as findings (GR6 was classified only later in TRACE-X as tracked freeze debt). The npsc42 gate was debt handed forward to HARNESS-FINAL/QUAL-X; the HARNESS-FINAL record has no npsc mention; resolved only by the EBH-7 allowlist refresh. Closure language overstates evidence completeness.
recommendation: Owner reconciles W7/W8 records with explicit classification of the failures; parent notes the debt-handoff gap.

title: CTRL-X FRZ-CTL-01 (incl. regression protection) is PASS while 15 Security qualification tests fail at HEAD and are deferred to QUAL-X
impact: Record states 15/15 security tests fail at HEAD with owners classified (QUAL-X = 15) and still closes the Security plane. Whether these tests still fail at baseline and whether QUAL-X later fixed them was not checked here; if unresolved, the PASS for the regression-protection clause is not supported by passing tests.
recommendation: Campaign B runs the 15 security tests at baseline or locates QUAL-X closure evidence; owner scopes the FRZ-CTL-01 PASS wording.

title: Independence basis of closure acceptance is a bare phrase in all eight stages: external audit referenced, but auditor identity, protocol and audit artifact are not in the repository
impact: Q05 cannot be classified as HUMAN_PROTOCOL_03, IIAC_SESSION or OPERATOR_ONLY for any stage; these predate the IIAC regime. Systemic and likely duplicated by other batches; parent may merge.
recommendation: Parent decides whether a historical-acceptance basis statement is needed for ARCH-FREEZE entry.
